project: 铃芽之旅400毫米打印分件首版
source_scene: Official poster courtyard v38 in v56 blend
limits: 400 mm is the base outer diameter; distant forest, sky, character, virtual night world are excluded.
Painted damage under 0.025 mm and small detached remnants are excluded. Source-derived structural detail thickened and voxel-unified at 0.28 mm.
The six-panel door has been rebuilt at print-safe thickness with a separate leaf and pin hinge. Door handle/panels are simplified.
PLA and 0.4 mm nozzle are assumptions. Test coupon and a door sample need real printing before the full batch.
3MF projects are offline; no printer upload or print job is initiated.
